name: How long does a typical drywall replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drywall replacement project varies significantly based on the scope and complexity. A small patch job might take a few hours, while replacing drywall in a single room could span 1-3 days, factoring in drying times for joint compound layers. A larger project, such as an entire home or multiple rooms, can take several days to over a week. Factors like surface preparation, extent of damage, and finishing requirements also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope; small repairs take hours, a single room 1-3 days, and larger projects several days to over a week, including drying times.
